messages:
Lena (Design): quick brainstorm: a horizontal "pillboard" for latency rows — p95 prominent, a thin scanline heatmap for the last hour, and a tiny sample badge. aim: dense fleet scanning (50+ routes). thoughts?
Elliot (PM): sounds good. customers often open dashboards to triage regressions; we want quick red/green states and one-click to traces. keep the pill height <= 56px.
Devon (Eng): backend can deliver p95 + 12-bin scanline if we pre-aggregate. exact histos on demand. perf caveat: many pills triggering live queries can spike load. recommend lazy-load details and batch requests.
Ravi (Data): agree. API proposal: `GET /metrics/latency?routes[]=...&bins=12&approx=true` returns `{p95, scanline:[...], sample_rate}`. include `confidence` for p95. UI should show a tiny `~` when sample_rate<1.
Maya (Accessibility): quick a11y checklist: 
- color-only heatmap state isn't sufficient; include an up/down glyph and text label (e.g., "p95 +120ms").
- scanline must be keyboard-focusable; focus opens an expanded summary pane.
- provide textual alt summary for screen readers: e.g., "Most requests 10-50ms; increased tail between 10:30-10:40".
Lena (Design): copy thoughts: pill primary: `p95 230ms`, secondary: `~10% sampled` (when applicable). hover/expand shows trend heatmap + `Open traces` CTA.
Elliot (PM): sampling copy should warn about cost simply: "Approximate values from 10% sampling. Run exact query for precise metrics (may take 10-30s)." link to docs.
Ravi (Data): tweak: include confidence: "p95 ≈ 230ms (±20ms)" so users see uncertainty.
Devon (Eng): implement exact run as background job; UI shows spinner and caches results for a short TTL. also add rate limit on exact runs per org to protect infra.
Maya (Accessibility): ensure uncertainty text is read by screen readers and don't convey it by opacity alone. also ensure focus rings are visible at small sizes.
ci-bot: canary deploy pillboard-latency to staging: https://staging.redwood/team/dashboards
Lena (Design): I'll make compact and expanded mocks + keyboard flow notes. dropping Figma link in 2h. please flag any must-have data fields for the API before I finalize. :coffee:
